2609.17107.title: Symbolic Separation: Grounding Deep Agents in Knowledge Graphs for Trustworthy Operational Data Analytics
2609.17107.paper_summary: Generative AI promises natural language access to the massive numerical telemetry of data centers and Industry 4.0 installations, yet text-to-query and tool-using agents stay unreliable: even frontier models answer little more than half of real-world database questions, and far fewer of the multi-step, operational ones, because the LLM must compose how heterogeneous sources relate and hallucinates the relations, not just the fields. We propose symbolic separation: a deep agent reasons freely but may act on data only through an ontology-constrained Virtual Knowledge Graph with deterministic pre-execution validation. Unlike a tool API's interface contract, this domain-semantic contract turns a complex question into one validated graph traversal instead of LLM-inferred joins. Instantiated as the Neurosymbolic Deep Analyst and evaluated on 49.9 TB of superconputer telemetry against a rigid workflow and a non-symbolic ablation, it raises end-to-end task success from 43% to 86%, prevents silent data-integrity errors that no syntactic check catches, and cuts token cost by 2.4x, letting a smaller on-premise model outperform a larger one.
2609.17107.paper_summary_zh: 生成式AI承諾能夠自然語言訪問數據中心和工業4.0安裝的大量數字遙測數據，然而文本查詢和工具使用代理仍然不可靠：即使是前沿模型也僅能回答現實世界數據庫問題的一半多一點，對於多步驟的操作性問題更是少之又少，因為大型語言模型必須組合異質來源之間的關係並幻想這些關係，而不僅僅是字段。我們提出符號分離：一個深度代理可以自由推理，但只能通過受本體約束的虛擬知識圖進行數據操作，並且具有確定性的預執行驗證。與工具API的接口合同不同，這種領域語義合同將複雜問題轉化為一次經過驗證的圖遍歷，而不是大型語言模型推斷的連接。作為神經符號深度分析師實現，並在49.9 TB的超級計算機遙測數據上進行評估，對比嚴格的工作流程和非符號性消融，將端到端任務成功率從43%提高到86%，防止了任何語法檢查無法捕捉的靜默數據完整性錯誤，並將令牌成本降低了2.4倍，使得較小的本地模型超越了較大的模型。
